name: How long does a typical water softener installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical water softener installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard water softener installations typically take a few hours to a half-day. However, the exact time can vary depending on factors like the existing plumbing configuration in your home and whether new lines need to be run. CG Plumbing Solutions assesses these details during the initial consultation to provide an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard water softener installation usually takes a few hours, but depends on existing plumbing and complexity.
